newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TENNIS-ROMANIA GAIN EARLY LEAD OVER DUTCH.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ROMANIA GAIN EARLY LEAD OVER DUTCH.

text.p: Romania's Adrian Voinea won an important point for his country by beating Paul Haarhuis of the Netherlands in the opening singles of their Davis Cup world group first round tie, on Friday.
Voinea, Romania's top player, came from behind to win 4-6 6-1 6-3 6-3 in two hours and 39 minutes.
Romanian number two Andrei Pavel and Dutch number one Jan Siemerink were playing the second singles later on Friday.
